Platform Overview

One unified platform for data, models, agents and applications

Integrated support for data connections, ML pipelines, model registry, inference validation, agent lifecycle management, MCP servers, LLM governance, observability, and GitHub automation.

ML & DataOps

Connect data sources, ingest datasets, run training pipelines, validate inference, and register models.

Governance & Observability

Why a unified AI platform

The hidden layers of enterprise-grade AI applications

What people see is building AI use cases. What enterprise readiness actually requires runs much deeper — and the layers that get overlooked are where projects break.

On the surface

Building AI use cases

What most teams focus on first.

End user

AI builder

"Empower me to build agents that solve end-user issues" — across low-code, no-code and pro-code.

Below the surface

What enterprise readiness requires

The layers that decide whether an AI project survives production.

A consistent foundation

One reliable way to build, with reusable platform components and unified infra & model management.

Governance from day one

Platform key features

What you get out of the box

Capabilities that take teams from experimentation to production-grade AI engineering.

VS Code plugin

Develop agents in the IDE with debugging, dependency handling, and experiment tracking.

Agent Designer

Visually design, register, deploy, and discover agents and MCP servers.

GitHub automation

Onboard, import and export agents; trigger environment-specific deployments from pipelines.

A2A & MCP support

Interoperable agent-to-agent and Model Context Protocol communication built in.

Responsible AI — Salus

Guardrails, security, and RAI adherence integrated across the platform.

Monitoring & observability

Langfuse-based traces and metrics, agent debugging, and centralized LLM access via LiteLLM.

Data connections & pipelines

Connect PostgreSQL, S3, Azure Blob and REST/Bedrock/Azure OpenAI; build data ready for training.

Model registry & inference validation

Train from on-prem and cloud data, register models, and validate inference.

Poly-cloud deployment

Deploy across GCP, Azure and AWS — plus edge and on-prem environments.

Frameworks & technology stack

Built on proven open-source foundations

An extensible architecture that integrates best-in-class components across every layer — from presentation and agent fabric to LLMs, backend, gateways, infrastructure, and CI/CD.

Conclusion

A converged platform, not just a toolkit

Essedum stands out by bringing together what would otherwise require multiple separate tools — data pipelines, ML model management, and AI agents — in one converged platform.

  • Converged — data pipelines, ML model management and AI agents in one place.
  • Telecom-tuned — domain optimizations with a 5G / edge focus.
  • Extensible — integrates open-source components like Langfuse, A2A and Thoth.
  • Enterprise-ready — security and governance built in from the start.

This makes Essedum not just a toolkit, but a strategic enabler for AI-driven transformation in the networking space.
